conclusion: No method leads every available held-out identification cell: SSAE Linear (constrained sigmoid-L0) is the most frequent leader in 42/162 separately evaluated dataset, LLM, and metric cells. Direct best-family comparisons are gemma: SSAE 52, SAE 11, ties 3 across 66 best-family cells; most frequent within-SSAE leader SSAE Linear (constrained sigmoid-L0); matched nonlinear SSAE 93, SAE 96, ties 9, pythia: SSAE 49, SAE 16, ties 1 across 66 best-family cells; most frequent within-SSAE leader SSAE Linear (constrained sigmoid-L0); matched nonlinear SSAE 90, SAE 99, ties 9. LLM metric values are not pooled. Frozen nonlinear SSAE realized active-axis capacity is gemma mean 33.1%, range 8.7% (sycophancy, SSAE ReLU (penalized)) to 100.0% (bias-in-bios, SSAE JumpReLU (penalized)); pythia mean 83.1%, range 17.9% (sycophancy, SSAE TopK (penalized)) to 100.0% (bias-in-bios, SSAE JumpReLU (penalized)) across separately retained dataset and method cells.

source_provenance.realized_active_axis_capacity: for nonlinear antipodal SSAEs, count independent axes whose absolute h_positive - h_negative coefficient reaches the frozen 0.01 activity threshold on cfc_train delta_z or its exact reverse; counts and fractions are aggregated only within dataset, LLM, method, and seed
source_provenance.representation_axis_selection: one latent response coordinate per concept selected by train-only Pearson Hungarian matching; the corresponding decoder axis is then evaluated
source_provenance.representation_concept_weighting: concepts averaged equally within each dataset-method-seed before seed uncertainty
source_provenance.representation_evaluation: signed cosine with factor-times-delta_z on cfc_test only; negative values are retained as anti-alignment
source_provenance.representation_orientation: orientation fixed by the sign of the latent-response train correlation, not by a separate decoder-projection fit
